property_summary: For any caller and any block/tx where C.fallback is invoked with exactly 10 ether and increasing timestamp, the reference contract only transfers its entire balance to msg.sender when block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant flips this to != 0 so there exist block numbers where the reference keeps its balance but the mutant sends it (or vice versa).
change_summary: Change the divisibility condition so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering which calls cause a transfer and potentially whether they revert due to out-of-gas in the callee.
